verdict.rationale: Navan lists receipt scanning and flags transactions against policy. Its MCP server and Ava assistant can explain why an expense was flagged and find policy violations, which amounts to a policy-audit layer. There is no evidence that AI codes expenses or detects duplicates or fraud. Missing for 10: AI receipt extraction details, automatic category/GL coding suggestions, memo generation, duplicate detection, fraud detection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
